name: Missy Elliott
biography: Missy Elliott, also known as "Misdemeanor," is a revolutionary American rapper, singer, songwriter, and record producer who has redefined the landscape of hip-hop and R&B for over three decades. Known for her avant-garde music videos and innovative production style—often alongside long-time collaborator Timbaland—she is the best-selling female rapper in Nielsen Music history.
